open_questions.text: Was the policy in force on the date of loss?
establishing_criteria: PAS policy status is in force on the date of loss

open_questions.text: Was the water damage sudden and accidental rather than gradual?
establishing_criteria: Technical statement of the failure mechanism by a qualified person
Evidence that the damage began at or immediately before the reported loss date

open_questions.text: When did the leak or damage begin?
establishing_criteria: Technical evidence of when the leak or corrosion began

open_questions.text: Which areas were affected by the reported event?
establishing_criteria: Each affected area linked to the reported event

open_questions.text: Is the claimed repair cost reasonable and supported?
establishing_criteria: Estimate reconciling to the surveyor scope

open_questions.text: Which water-damage sublimit applies on the date of loss?
establishing_criteria: Applicable endorsement wording effective on the date of loss
